messages:
Elena R: quick q — PR #4823 added `model_used` to /v1/generate responses and a new `routing_hint` request param. Are we sure this is backwards-compatible with old clients?
Samir: short answer: yes, server defaults keep old behavior if `routing_hint` missing. new fields are additive. but two gotchas: 1) fallback selection order changed, 2) streaming frames include `model_used` now.
Janel: can you expand on the fallback change? our mobile SDKs rely on the old deterministic fallback sequence.
Samir: before: fallback was fixed list [preferred -> compatible siblings -> default]. now: we route by policy (region/tier) first, then by compatibility. so if `routing_hint: region:eu` and a compatible sibling is only in us, it won't be chosen. that can change probabilities for clients that relied on geographic indifference.
Mike T: putting a short example for the API contract we discussed. please sanity-check:
```json
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model_id": "rw-instruct-llama-70b",
  "prompt": "Summarize...",
  "routing_hint": "region:us-west,tier:dedicated",
  "fallback_models": ["rw-instruct-llama-33b","rw-instruct-llama-13b"]
}

200 OK
{
  "id": "resp_123",
  "model_used": "rw-instruct-llama-70b-quant",
  "choices": [...],
  "meta": {"effective_region": "us-west-2"}
}
```
Janel: thanks — so SDKs that parse responses must tolerate missing `model_used` (older responses) and also accept it as a string when present. we should add a minor version bump to the client libs.
Cheng: small note on `routing_hint` syntax: we've got historical variants like `region=us-west` and `region:us-west`. server recognizes both but we should standardize in docs. prefer `region:us-west,tier:premium` (colon + comma-delimited).
Elena R: what about streaming? will the first event/frame include `model_used`?
Samir: yes — streaming now emits an initial `metadata` frame with { "model_used": "...", "effective_region": "..." }. if a client can't parse it, it can keep ignoring frames until token frames. older clients will still work because token frames are unchanged. add a migration note: check streaming parser tolerates an extra JSON metadata frame.
Mike T: added a small compatibility test to the runtime e2e suite: sending a request without `routing_hint` -> expect `model_used` may be absent in non-streaming but present in later responses. pushed branch `e2e/resp-model-used` -> CI flaky on macos, will rerun.
infra-bot: deploy scheduled: canary runtime rollout with response-field toggle to 10% at 2026-03-17T15:30Z (PR #4823).
Janel: action items: 1) doc PR to standardize `routing_hint` syntax (I'm on it), 2) client libs minor bump + parser tolerant (Mike/TBD), 3) add e2e case that ensures region-pref routing respects `routing_hint` (Samir).
Elena R: pinging @Mike T and @Samir for code review on the runtime toggle — can you pls prioritize? :eyes:
Mike T: reviewing now, should be done by EOD. if any edge cases found I'll leave inline comments.
Cheng: will also add a small note in the model catalog: list models with their region availability to help SRE and product set expectations.
Elena R: perfect. will follow up with a short blurb for the release notes about additive `model_used` and routing_hint semantics. thanks all. :tada:
